name: Bellwort root
description: A pale root, knobbled like a knuckle. Chewed by miners for a cough, and by nobody for pleasure.
notes: Potion ingredient (mw-ju8.4): shop and loot stock only, with no use until a brewing system lands (a later bead). A bitter root from the glen's damp banks. Base value 6 sits in the economy ingredient band (3-15).
